findings.detail: The rules (close-out step 8, STATUS.md, every qNNN-approve-*-merge question) tell Max he is asked before the live database changes. Nothing enforces that. findings.title: A task whose After: prerequisite failed waits forever with no message
findings.detail: deps_met in bin/worker.sh (commit de9dd6d) looks only in queue/done/. When the prerequisite lands in queue/failed/ the dependent task is skipped silently on every cycle and the lane reports nothing; the brain had to unblock 144, 157 and 211 by hand (commit e8bc7fd, 'stale After on failed tasks'). The worker should say which pending task is waiting on which missing or failed task, or treat a failed prerequisite as a reason to file the dependent task as failed with a note.
